items.hook: The Courtship of Eddie's Father is a 1963 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Vincente Minnelli, starring Glenn Ford as Tom Corbett, a widowed father, and Ronny Howard as the titular son.
items.body: The film is based on the 1961 novel of the same name by Mark Toby. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Zły is a 1955 Polish novel by Leopold Tyrmand.
items.body: Set in post-war Warsaw, it follows a mysterious vigilante who wages a campaign against the city's criminal underworld. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: It is the longest running program in the history of television in Spain as it has been broadcast daily since 15 September 1957.
items.body: Telediario (Tele-journal) is the flagship television newscast produced by Televisión Española (TVE), the television division of Spanish state-owned public broadcaster Radiotelevisión Española (RTVE). One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: (Matthew) Edward McNulty (1856–1943) was an Irish playwright and novelist, known for his penned portrayals of Irish peasant life.
